policy.source_ownership: Program Kit owns AI guidance, scaffolding, selection rules, and compatibility tests; runtime source and release tests belong to the component repositories.
policy.versioning: Pin each family independently. Never infer a component version from the Program Kit version.
policy.compatibility: Program Kit may advance a family pin only after its consumer compatibility suite passes against published immutable packages.

api_baseline.when: A .NET HTTP API or modular host is selected.
notes: Use the Foundation host image only for runnable package composition; application behavior remains in consumer-owned packages.
Keep FoundationFeatureIdentity, assembly name, package ID, and ShellFeature identity equal.

browser_bff.when: A browser application uses server-managed authentication and cookies.

browser_spa_pkce.when: A static or independently hosted SPA holds access tokens.

service_to_service.when: A service calls an authenticated downstream API.

identity_administration.when: Trusted services administer users, clients, scopes, sessions, or provider configuration.
notes: Select the Keycloak adapter only when Keycloak is an accepted provider decision; business authorization remains outside the adapter.

openapi_export.when: A composed API contract must be exported for compatibility analysis or client generation.

public_discovery.when: The application explicitly publishes validated public metadata or documents.

domain_events.when: A bounded context needs in-process domain-event dispatch.
notes: Do not use domain events as durable integration events or as an outbox contract.

background_tasks.when: A shell owns startup, background, or recurring work.

forms_runtime.when: A product renders immutable, schema-driven forms.

forms_operations.when: A product stores drafts, submissions, or attachments.
notes: InMemory is a reference/development adapter, not a durable production choice.

forms_management.when: Trusted operators author, validate, publish, or retire forms and localization catalogs.

forms_authoring_frontend.when: Trusted operators need visual and source authoring or modeler integration.

localization_storage.when: Localization catalogs require a selected persistence adapter.
notes: InMemory is a reference/development adapter, not a durable production choice.

non_negotiable_boundaries: Orbyss is a software factory and AI consultancy; these packages are reusable building blocks, not an Orbyss platform.
Program Kit must not copy or compile Foundation or Forms runtime source.
Consumer bounded contexts own business semantics, authorization meaning, pricing, workflow, and publication policy.
Select one browser authentication profile and one concrete storage adapter per owned storage contract.
MCP tool contributors depend on Orbyss.Foundation.Mcp.AspNetCore; they do not own transport or anonymous access.
Keep locked restore, central package management, explicit package-source mapping, and exact family pins.
